notes.title: Critical update for uncontrolled fishers!
notes.notes:
Critical update to fix normal chatters being given elevated permissions - incorrectly allowing them to fish with a chat message even though the chat trigger is disabled, multicast, and cast on behalf of other users.

This should all be fixed now!

Special thanks to everyone on the discord who helped me debug this one <3

I'm currently still working on a fix for LurkBait disconnecting quietly during long streams, so stay tuned for that coming soon :-)

notes.title: Urgent Update: Connection Issues
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, new update to resolve the ongoing connection issues is now live! If you're having connection issues, please update to the latest version.

In a related note, due to some complications with Twitch's new API on my end, the feature to send chat messages from a secondary chatbot account has been temporarily disabled. I'm working on fixing the issue ASAP and any LurkBait chat messages will still send from your main account in the meantime.

I'll be monitoring the situation closely over the next few days and continue making updates to keep things running as smoothly as I can.

Apologies for any inconvenience and happy fishing!

notes.title: Quick leaderboard bugfix!
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everybody who has purchased, reviewed, tweeted, and shared LurkBait, this launch has been so amazing so far thanks entirely to all of YOU!

Thanks everyone who alerted me to an issue crashing the game when users fish during the leaderboard screen. This should be fixed now! I've also added a different (!) icons for epic and legendary catches.

There's a few exciting new features coming soon based off of your suggestions so keep an eye out!
